name: bao-run
summary: Use when a command needs an OpenBao token: log in, run it, then revoke the token

exit_codes.0: the command succeeded; any code not listed here is the command's own exit status
exit_codes.3: a setting is missing or invalid, the config file is unusable, or curl or jq is missing
exit_codes.65: access file unreadable, password line missing, or delegated token file unreadable or empty
exit_codes.126: the command is not executable (token revoked)
exit_codes.127: the command was not found (token revoked)
exit_codes.129: HUP received: the command was stopped and the token revoked
exit_codes.130: INT received before the command started, or under Bash older than 4.4 (TERM forwarded)
exit_codes.143: TERM received: the command was stopped and the token revoked
